E_MUC1_ABUNDANCE.label: Bulk epithelial MUC1 abundance (proposed, U6b evaluation)
E_MUC1_ABUNDANCE.measurement_proxies: MUC1 core protein or mRNA abundance
E_MUC1_ABUNDANCE.notes: U6b in-memory evaluation only; not in any model.
E_MUC1_ABUNDANCE.state_1_meaning: MUC1 raised by the progestin-driven state
E_MUC1_ABUNDANCE.uncertainty_or_alternative_interpretatio: Driver not distinguished by the source (E_SECRETORY_STATE vs E_PGR)

E_MUC1_LOCAL_CLEARANCE.label: Local apical MUC1 clearance (proposed, U6b evaluation)
E_MUC1_LOCAL_CLEARANCE.measurement_proxies: local apical MUC1 loss by confocal localisation
E_MUC1_LOCAL_CLEARANCE.notes: U6b in-memory evaluation only; not in any model.
E_MUC1_LOCAL_CLEARANCE.state_1_meaning: MUC1 locally absent at the embryo site, epithelium intact
E_MUC1_LOCAL_CLEARANCE.uncertainty_or_alternative_interpretatio: Determinant undetermined; embryo-induced apoptosis not excluded

claim_boundary: EVALUATION ONLY. No member is adopted, none is written to any network.bnd, and no model version is created. Structural and design facts are exhaustive enumerations; endpoints are exact fixed-point values weighted by baseline.cfg priors, which converged MaBoSS reproduces (docs/endpoint_convergence_finding.md). No transient, declared-horizon value, rate or simulation enters. Structural effect and biological licensing are separate axes.
